title: 第283章这两人不能留了
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈卫东的目光瞬间变得凌厉，当下就做出了判断。

对这两个不知道感恩的，还想着害他性命的人，是不能留了！

当着这两人的面，陈卫东直接进入了空间。

而随着他进空间，这两个猎户被吓了一大跳。

因为他们之前从未见过这样的情况，没有遇到过这样邪门的事情。

好好的人，怎么就突然消失在眼前了？

难道他们是遇到鬼了吗？

方才那小子不是人？

就在这两个猎户有些慌神的时候，陈卫东突然又从空间里出来。

只不过这次他出现在他们的身后。

陈卫东已经拿好了猎枪，对着两个猎户瞄准，砰砰就直接两枪过去了。

随着陈卫东的两枪过去，这两个猎户也跟着倒地。

陈卫东不放心，多补了两枪，确定了这两人死透了后，这才敢放下猎枪。

看着倒在血泊中的两人，陈卫东上前检查了一下，确认他们是真死了。

前后两世，陈卫东还是第一次杀人。

但是他对自己做的事情并不后悔。

严格意义上说，他这不算是故意杀人，而是自卫。

如果不是这两个猎户先拿着猎枪指着他，陈卫东也不至于对这两人动手。

既然是自卫，陈卫东自然不用有什么心理负罪感。

只是说是这么说，他在心里这样安慰自己。

可这件事到底比较严重，杀人不是杀鸡，不可能做到心里毫无波澜。

陈卫东坐了下来，随后拿出来了一根香烟抽了起来。

其实他平时不爱抽烟，但这时候不一样。

遇到心情烦闷的时候，陈卫东还是想着抽一根香烟解解闷的。

等一根香烟抽完了，陈卫东这才看着地上的两具尸体，思索着怎么处理。

若直接将这两人埋在山里，还是可能会被发现。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Chen Weidong's eyes became sharp in an instant, and he made a judgment immediately.

These two people who are ungrateful and still want to harm his life cannot be kept!

In front of these two people, Chen Weidong entered the space directly.

As he entered the space, the two hunters were startled.

Because they have never seen such a situation before, and have never encountered such evil things.

Why did such a good person suddenly disappear before his eyes?

Did they encounter a ghost?

Isn’t that guy a human just now?

Just when the two hunters were a little panicked, Chen Weidong suddenly came out of the space again.

Only this time he appeared behind them.

Chen Weidong had already picked up the shotgun, aimed at the two hunters, and fired two shots at them.

As Chen Weidong's two shots passed, the two hunters also fell to the ground.

Chen Weidong was worried and fired two more shots. After making sure that the two men were dead, he dared to put down the shotgun.

Looking at the two people lying in a pool of blood, Chen Weidong stepped forward to check and confirm that they were really dead.

In two lifetimes, this was the first time Chen Weidong killed someone.

But he has no regrets about what he did.

Strictly speaking, this was not intentional homicide, but self-defense.

If the two hunters hadn't pointed their shotguns at him first, Chen Weidong wouldn't have taken action against them.

Since it was self-defense, Chen Weidong naturally did not need to feel any psychological guilt.

Just saying that, he comforted himself in his heart.

But this matter is more serious after all. Killing people is not killing chickens, and it is impossible to feel calm.

Chen Weidong sat down, then took out a cigarette and started smoking.

In fact, he usually doesn't like to smoke, but this time is different.

When he feels depressed, Chen Weidong still thinks of smoking a cigarette to relieve his boredom.

After finishing smoking a cigarette, Chen Weidong looked at the two corpses on the ground and thought about how to deal with them.

If these two people were buried directly in the mountain, they might still be discovered.
